text: A simple illustration of photorealistic, view 3/4, normal shooting, which depicts three 30 yo mercenary fighters dressed in absolutely identical futuristic black Kevlar combat gear. The first is a joyful dark-haired European man standing to the right and in front of the others, the second is a Latin American man standing half-turned on the left, bending down to pick up a bag and turning his head towards the camera, The third a pensive Japanese man sitting in the center on a military gun case. Next to them on the floor are five black sports backpacks, and behind them are three military cases. General background: spaceship wall, black metal floor, dark and subdued lighting. Detailed faces, dynamic poses in motion, correct finger anatomy.
